board.notes: Vendor model identified; the actual PCB revision and wiring have not been audited.

wifi.credential_storage_build_policy: C6 Wi-Fi driver NVS disabled by nvs_enable=0; P4 app stores plaintext credential record
wifi.notes: C6 was upgraded by P4/SDIO using a temporary ESP-Hosted 2.13.1 legacy RPC host and application image 3.1.0. After restoring the 3.1.0 P4 host, runtime reported matching firmware, RPC V2, target esp32c6 and identity success. Wi-Fi/IP operation and credential persistence remain unverified; no Wi-Fi Ready state is inferred from transport success.

ethernet.notes: Vendor-documented RJ45/PHY; exact revision, PHY address, clock and reset wiring require audit.

camera.notes: User reports connected UC-439 rev.B and sensor names IMX219/OV5647. These are alternative identities pending actual sensor detection, not two verified sensors or confirmed driver support.

usb.notes: Audit OTG device routing, jumpers and VBUS. Do not connect two hosts or use an ordinary A-to-A cable.

wifi_credential_storage.notes: P4 application is the only persistent owner by source configuration. ESP-Hosted 3.1.0 forwards nvs_enable=0 to C6 Wi-Fi initialization. The remote esp_wifi_set_storage API is a no-op. Flash dumps can reveal saved SSID and passphrase.

hmac_efuse.historical_authorization: BLOCK_KEY0 HMAC_UP with read/write protection only; completed 2026-11-08

evidence.claim: Read-only ROM queries observed P4 rev.1.3 and 16 MiB flash; PCB revision remains unknown. BLOCK_KEY0/HMAC_UP metadata is documented in the current security section.
Model has P4, C6/SDIO, 16 MiB Flash, 32 MiB PSRAM, IP101GRI Ethernet, MIPI-CSI and USB OTG HS; these are vendor facts, not runtime readiness.
OV5647 has an upstream sensor driver; actual camera/cable compatibility remains unknown.
Upstream esp_video UVC example supports ESP32-P4; combined UVC/HTTP/RTSP is not yet integrated.

needs_verification: Actual sensor, connector, ribbon orientation, supply and XCLK

PHY address, RMII clock/reset and all assigned GPIOs

Actual Flash/PSRAM boot probe and camera DMA/cache requirements
Plain NVS app_config read/write/reboot persistence and C6 no-duplicate-write behavior on hardware
JPEG profile compatibility with UVC and RFC 2435 RTSP packetizer
